answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by making each identity costly to build and cheap to audit. Agents must stake collateral and earn reputation over time, so a yarrow of fake accounts cannot harvest rewards without paying first. Work is sampled and peer-scored, and a kernel of correlated low-effort copies is exposed by shared funding trails and identical timing. A jade of independent attestations, weighted by verifier stake, turns mass duplication into a money-losing strategy.
